cards.notes: This combines a simple resource gain with the same end-of-turn promote-another-played-card pattern seen on Ambassador.

global_conditions.description: Effect includes deferred or triggered timing

cards.name: Quaggoth
cards.rules_text: Assassinate a white troop for each site you control.
cards.notes: The effect counts all sites currently under your control, not only sites with a control marker present. It grants that many free white-troop assassinations and resolves as many as possible if legal white targets run short.

cards.name: Rather Modar
cards.rules_text: Draw 2 cards. Place a spy.
cards.notes: Straight additive effect card. The spy instruction uses the established default spy placement rule.

cards.name: Ravenous Zombies
cards.rules_text: Gain 1 power. Assassinate a white troop.
cards.notes: Uses standard free white-troop assassination legality.

cards.name: Red Dragon
cards.rules_text: Supplant a troop. Return an enemy spy. Gain 1 VP for each total controlled site.
cards.notes: This is sequential, not modal. `Supplant a troop` uses normal supplant legality: any enemy troop at a site where you have presence. `Return enemy spy` uses normal enemy-spy return legality as a free card effect, so the target spy must be within your presence and returns to its owner's barracks. The VP clause counts all sites currently under your control.

cards.name: Red Wyrmling
cards.rules_text: Gain 2 power and 2 influence.
cards.notes: Simple fixed resource card with no timing or targeting questions.

cards.name: Revenant
cards.rules_text: Assassinate 2 troops. If you have 8 or more trophies, promote this card.
cards.notes: The assassinations follow standard free assassinate legality. The threshold uses generic `trophies` wording (not `player trophies`) and therefore counts trophies broadly.

global_conditions.description: Effect has conditional branch or threshold requirement

cards.name: Severin Silrajin
cards.rules_text: Gain 5 power.
cards.notes: Simple fixed resource card with no timing or targeting questions.

cards.name: Skeletal Horde
cards.rules_text: Deploy 2 troops. You can devour this card to deploy 3 more troops.
cards.notes: Interpreted as additive (not modal), because no `or` delimiter is present. The self-devour clause is an optional rider.

cards.name: Soldier
cards.rules_text: Gain 1 power.
cards.notes: Bare `power` on this starter card means gain 1 power.

cards.name: Spectator
cards.rules_text: Gain 2 power and 1 influence.
cards.notes: Simple fixed resource card with no timing or targeting questions.

cards.name: Spellspinner
cards.rules_text: Choose exactly one mode. Either place a spy, or return one of your spies to supplant a troop at that site.
cards.notes: Uses established modal `or` rule, default self-return-spy rule, and normal supplant mechanics. `There` means former site of returned spy.

cards.name: Spy Master
cards.rules_text: Place a spy.
cards.notes: Uses established default spy placement rule.

cards.name: Succubus
cards.rules_text: Devour a card from your hand to place a spy and assassinate a troop there.
cards.notes: Devouring a card from hand is a required cost. The devoured card goes to the normal devour pile permanently.

cards.name: Ulitharid
cards.rules_text: Choose a market card that costs 4 or less. Play it immediately by resolving its instructions without recruiting it. After its full effect finishes, devour that card. While it is being played this way, it does not count for aspect checks or end-of-turn effects.
cards.notes: This is a temporary market-card play effect with a cost cap and an immediate post-resolution devour.

cards.name: Umber Hulk
cards.rules_text: Deploy 3 troops. If an opponent causes you to discard this card, that opponent discards a card.
cards.notes: The trigger applies only when an opponent effect makes this card move from hand to discard pile. When that happens, the same opponent discards 1 card from hand.

global_conditions.description: Effect has conditional branch or threshold requirement

cards.name: Underdark Ranger
cards.rules_text: Assassinate 2 white troops.
cards.notes: This means two separate free assassinations of neutral white troops using normal legality. If fewer than 2 legal white targets exist, resolve as many as possible, including zero.

cards.name: Vampire
cards.rules_text: Choose exactly one mode. Either supplant a troop, or promote a card from your discard pile and then gain 1 VP for every 3 promoted cards.
cards.notes: Uses the established modal `or` rule. The VP scaling follows the established promoted-card counting rule and rounds down by groups of 3.

cards.name: Vampie Spawn
cards.rules_text: Gain 1 influence. Return another player's troop or spy.
cards.notes: Workbook name appears misspelled (`Vampie Spawn`). Return clause reuses established enemy-unit return semantics.

cards.name: Vanifer
cards.rules_text: Assassinate a troop. Recruit a Malice card that costs 4 or less.
cards.notes: Straight additive effect card. Bare `assassinate a troop` uses the established free standard assassinate rule.

cards.name: Vrock
cards.rules_text: Choose exactly one mode. Either place a spy, or return one of your own spies from the board to your barracks and gain 5 power.
cards.notes: Reuses the established modal spy-or-return-spy-for-power family.

cards.name: Watcher of Thay
cards.rules_text: Choose exactly one mode. Either place a spy, or return one of your spies and gain 3 influence.
cards.notes: This reuses the established modal `or` structure, default spy placement rule, and self-return-for-reward shorthand.

cards.name: Water Elemental
cards.rules_text: Deploy 2 troops. If the focus condition is met for Conquest, draw a card.
cards.notes: Straight additive effect card with a separate Conquest focus draw bonus.

global_conditions.description: Requires matching-aspect support card in hand or played zone
Effect has conditional branch or threshold requirement

cards.name: Water Elemental Myrmidon
cards.rules_text: Assassinate a white troop. At end of turn, promote an Obedience card played this turn.
cards.notes: This uses the established white-troop assassination rule plus the established aspect-filtered end-of-turn promote family. If no Obedience card was played this turn, the promote clause does nothing.

global_conditions.description: Effect includes deferred or triggered timing

cards.name: Weaponmaster
cards.rules_text: Choose exactly one mode. Either deploy 1 troop, or assassinate a white troop.
cards.notes: Uses established modal `or` rule. Assassinate branch uses normal free card-effect assassinate legality, limited to neutral white troops.

cards.name: White Dragon
cards.rules_text: Deploy 3 troops. Gain 1 VP for every 2 sites controlled.
cards.notes: The VP scaling counts all sites currently under the player's control and rounds down by groups of 2. The troop deployment uses the established free multi-deploy rule.

cards.name: White Wyrmling
cards.rules_text: Deploy 2 troops. You may devour a card in the market.
cards.notes: Workbook benefit text was wrong here. This uses usual `devour` keyword and mechanic: choose market-row card, move it to devour pile, and it never returns to game.

cards.name: Wight
cards.rules_text: Choose exactly one mode. Either gain 2 power, or devour a card from your hand to supplant a troop.
cards.notes: Uses the established modal `or` convention. The second mode requires devouring one card from hand as part of the effect, then performing a standard supplant.

cards.name: Wraith
cards.rules_text: Place a spy. You may devour this card to assassinate a troop there.
cards.notes: `There` refers to the site where the spy was placed. The assassinate uses standard assassinate legality at that site, and devouring this card is the cost for that rider.

cards.name: Wyrmspeaker
cards.rules_text: Gain 1 influence. At end of turn, promote a played card other than this card.
cards.notes: This uses the same target rule as Cleric of Laogzed: it must promote a different played card. If there is no other played card at end of turn, the effect does nothing.

global_conditions.description: Effect includes deferred or triggered timing

cards.name: Yan-C-Bin
cards.rules_text: Place a spy, then assassinate a troop at that site. If the focus condition is met, place another spy.
cards.notes: Workbook shorthand was misleading here. Focus on Guile follows the current repo rule: another Guile card in hand or already played. When that condition is met, Yan-C-Bin grants one additional separate spy placement after the base spy-plus-assassinate effect.

global_conditions.description: Requires matching-aspect support card in hand or played zone
Effect has conditional branch or threshold requirement

cards.name: Zuggtmoy
cards.rules_text: Devour a card in your inner circle to gain 3 influence and at end of turn promote up to 2 other played cards.
cards.notes: Devouring a card in your inner circle means devouring one of your promoted cards from that zone as a required cost, sending it to the normal devour pile permanently. The end-of-turn clause promotes up to 2 other played cards.

global_conditions.description: Effect includes deferred or triggered timing
